result:
I’d make empathy a condition of power.

Anyone governing, judging, directing, or making life-changing decisions would have to fully confront the consequences for the people least able to resist them—not merely understand them intellectually, but feel the weight of them. Most cruelty persists because those in power can remain insulated from those harmed. If that insulation became impossible, a great deal of injustice would become much harder to perpetuate.
